title: File AltBoxPath allocation publication gate
contracts: Dll_GetTlsNameBuffer output must be checked before wmemcpy writes into it
The alternate mount-point path must be copied into a local allocation before File_AltBoxPath is published
File_AltBoxPathLen is published only after the pointer is non-null and initialized
This SREV does not change mount-point conversion semantics prefix order raw-root fallback semantics or file policy
runtime_gate: Windows mount-point alternate box path smoke plus allocation failure injection for Dll_GetTlsNameBuffer and Dll_Alloc
